in_marathi.name: प्रविण
in_marathi.long_meaning: प्रविण हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। प्रविण means 'bright' or 'shining'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prav', which means 'to shine'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to bring light and positivity into the world.
